title: Compact per-step observation (state_space.v1), wire format
description: The policy reads a newline-delimited text block, not JSON. This file documents the line grammar and the column order, because the encoding is positional and a reader cannot recover it from the text alone. Every integer is the underlying float divided by a fixed scale, so the wire carries no decimal points.

EPI.note: Episode header. One calendar month. Teacher and evaluation runs carry the book in from the previous month; an RL training episode starts from a fresh portfolio.

T.note: Step header. session is always PM: decisions are close-only, one per trading day.

M.form: M <underlying> ret rv iv dv w ts sk bf fi doi
M.note: One row per underlying. A missing field is the MISSING sentinel, never zero. The policy is never shown a price level or a spot quote.

A.form: A nlv cash bp util rlz unrlz dd npos nD nV

columns.rlz: realized PnL since the run began, scale 1e2

N.note: News changelog. Append-only across the episode: an item is served once, when it first becomes available, and is not re-served. direction is +, -, 0 or ? ; horizon is a small integer or ? . See examples/news_schema.json.

R.note: Receipt for a filled order, reporting the coordinates ACTUALLY obtained. A request and a fill are never assumed equal.

action_grammar.form: one order line per reply line, nothing else
action_grammar.note: The policy never names a contract: no strike and no expiry appear in an action. Deterministic resolvers select contracts by nearest admissible delta. Naked shorts and equity legs are inadmissible.
